current_execution_trace.fact: Kimi integration local_cli uses adapter kimi and timeout_s=2400; catalog derives local-cli--kimi--evaluator.
Envelope/repo/registry/active-mode checks, adapter resolution and target lookup precede local-cli exec into sandbox-profile.sh. There is no separate local-cli-runner.sh.
effective_timeout=min(deadline_s, descriptor cap)=1800; argv is rendered as kimi -p <one inline envelope JSON argument> --output-format stream-json.

Parent START=date +%s; helper argv contains --timeout 1800 --term-grace 2 --status-file <R/timeout-task.json> --cwd <evaluation worktree> -- env -i <allowlisted env> <Kimi argv>. argv delivery has stdin=/dev/null and direct >log 2>&1. Bash waits for the helper PID and duration is end date +%s minus START.

Helper deadline uses time.time()+timeout, Popen starts a new session, polling is 20ms. Deadline calls descendant-group inspection, TERM, monotonic grace, KILL and reap. Status deadline/124 is written only after stop/reap returns. ps check_output has no timeout; the fallback proc.wait() also has no timeout. These are code-level unbounded cleanup points, not proven causes of this run.

Only helper reason=deadline plus exit124 becomes TIMEOUT. The TIMEOUT branch wins before artifact existence checks; validator maps it to CANCELED and the terminal branch to exit4. Artifact absence was separately checked on disk.

minimal_synthetic_replay_proposal.requires: Separate authorization for a short local mock-only diagnostic; not permission for another model/evaluation dispatch or framework repair.
plan: Use an owned temporary external-disk directory and standard-library-only mock; no registry/auth/model/dependencies/network. Test the direct helper's supported --timeout 1 or2, not a weakened production envelope bound.

Record wall and monotonic timestamps for mock launch, TERM receipt, exit, wrapper wait return and sidecar write; capture PID/PPID/PGID for only owned mock descendants. Use a separate short watchdog to avoid hanging diagnostics.

Case1: cooperative mock. Case2: mock ignores TERM with same-group and own-session descendants. Case3: separate descendant retains stdout, with direct regular-file redirection as in runner; compare with an explicitly piped variant to isolate pipe-drain behavior.

Case4: helper --clock-file hook advances past deadline, testing immediate detection after an artificial wall-clock jump without changing the host clock. Optional unit-level mocked ps/reap delays isolate the unbounded cleanup stages; they do not establish the historic r2 cause.

Compare unmodified helper and isolated instrumentation copy; originals and framework untouched. Preserve all failures, phase traces and SHA256s. Do not invoke Kimi, extend2400/1800, weaken deliverable/receipt gates, or reopen acceptance.
